integrity: The proof is self-contained from the definitions and the elementary geodesic structure of complete multipartite graphs. Earlier complete-multipartite general-position coloring results are explicitly separated from the new clique and domination formulas. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the (3,2) clique and domination invariants on complete multipartite graphs. Exhaustive verification through order 10 is a finite stress test and is not the infinite proof.
title: Exact \((3,2)\)-clique and \((3,2)\)-domination numbers of complete multipartite graphs
